name: OWASP_A05_Sensitive_File_Access
search: index=web_logs sourcetype="access_combined" | regex uri_path="(?i)(\.env|\.git\/|\.htaccess|config\.json|web\.config|settings\.py|database\.yml|\.aws\/credentials|\.ssh\/)" | stats count values(status) as http_statuses by src_ip, uri_path, http_user_agent | where http_statuses=200 OR http_statuses=304
description: OWASP A05: .env, .git kimi kritik konfiqurasiya fayllarina ugurlu girisleri tespit eder.
